'''Manganese''' was an element. Purple manganese, along with rich red [[Cinnabar/Legends|cinnabar]], lemony-orange [[sulfite]]s, and green rock made up the crust of [[Fiddanl]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="GG2" />
